gates.gate: Complexity must be LARGE or HIGH_RISK
External memory must be initialized and valid
Write scopes must be pre-defined and disjoint
At least 20 task graph nodes with parallelism
gates.check: Task graph has >=20 nodes with parallelizable groups

gates.gate: Vanilla baseline must exist for comparison
gates.check: Baseline single-agent run completed and recorded
No critical gaps from diagnostic gate

readinessForNextTrial: BUILD-5 can proceed when a LARGE project meets all 7 gates.
